answer: An identity bond that decays stops a tide of fake agents. Each agent locks 500 POA; the bond loses 2% per epoch and must be topped up, so one identity over a 20-epoch horizon costs 200 POA in decay. A zephyr of cheap copies fails: 100 fakes cost 50,000 POA upfront plus 20,000 POA in decay, earning nothing before review. Honest agents pay one bond only, keep a single identity topped up, and their earnings stay whole against the flood they blocked.
